name: io.github.ianderso/familysearch-mcp
title: FamilySearch
description: Genealogical research on FamilySearch: historical places, indexed records, page images, the tree.

environmentVariables.name: FS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Access token from your own registered FamilySearch application. The place gazetteer and collection catalogue work without one.

environmentVariables.name: FS_ENV_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Env file to read settings from and to re-read a refreshed token from mid-session. Defaults to the nearest .env from the working directory upward.

environmentVariables.name: FS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your registered application's client id, reported by auth_status.

environmentVariables.name: FS_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: production, or integration for the FamilySearch sandbox.
